headline: 斯科特·库珀被总统列为超级智能工作组负责人
summary: 特朗普于2026年10月4日宣布成立超级智能工作组，由国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿、联邦贸易委员会主席安德鲁·弗格森、战争部副部长埃米尔·迈克尔和人事管理局局长斯科特·库珀共同领导。

sources.title: Truth Social Posts of October 4, 2026
sources.publisher: 美国总统声明；The American Presidency Project 存档
sources.excerpt: will be led by Director of National Intelligence, Jay Clayton, Chairman of the Federal Trade Commission, Andrew Ferguson, Under Secretary of War for Research and Engineering, and Chief Technology Officer, Emil Michael, and Director of the Office of Personnel Management, Scott Kupor
